explanation: The implementation uses WP_HTML_Tag_Processor to scan linearly through the HTML document, finding all A tags with next_tag(). For each A tag found, it checks whether the href attribute exists using get_attribute() (which returns null if absent). When href is present—even with an empty value or no value like `<a href>` (which sets href to true per the documentation)—the target attribute is set to "_blank" using set_attribute(). Finally, get_updated_html() returns the modified HTML with byte-for-byte preservation of everything except the updated target attributes.
